column1: # Complete field branches: reference b94400 / classic b91440 use flags 0 in trade.
# Nonempty artifact language_name at artifact+8 -> a946e0 / a91760(name,out,true,false): English full name only, without native-name/quoted-English pair or item suffix.

# Ordinary complete item grammar is article before quality/wear/designation wrappers and actual +0x5e8 title; all 98 native title owners retained in item-info-title-sources.tsv and map-hover-item-sources.tsv.

# Mode-1 article slots: 95 item owners use c653e0; item_body_componentst, item_corpsepiecest and item_corpsest use ca0d60. Corpse override suppresses article for named owner or current Adventurer, otherwise the same definite article.
